dn-gfl.name: GFL fiber laser cutting machines, 5 × 10 to 6.6 × 20 ft, 3 – 40 kW
dn-gfl.summary: The GFL is Dener's production sheet laser: a gantry on a stress-relieved frame accelerating at 1.5 G to 394 ft/min, with a pallet changer so the next sheet is loaded while the first is cut. Three table sizes — 5 × 10, 6.6 × 13 and 6.6 × 20 ft — with fiber sources from 3 to 40 kW, a Precitec autofocus head, nesting software and production reports on the control, and the pneumatic extraction and scrap boxes that keep the floor clean. The machine for a job shop that cuts all day.

sf-compact.name: Compact enclosed sheet lasers, 4 × 4 and 5 × 10 ft, 1.5 – 12 kW
sf-compact.summary: The entry into fiber laser cutting: single-table enclosed machines that ship in one container, plug in and cut the day they arrive. The SF1313G is a 4 × 4 ft machine for small parts; the SF1530G, SF1530N and the fully enclosed SF1530NP with its electric lifting door take a 5 × 10 ft sheet with 1.5 to 12 kW sources — enough for 3/4″ mild steel at 6 kW. The pull-out table loads from the front with a forklift; the integrated source and cabinet keep the footprint under 200 × 90″. For jewellery, electronics and precision small parts the SFP series adds 24 to 49″ square tables with ±0.005 mm repeatability.

sf-coil.name: Coil-fed laser cutting lines, 0.03″ sheet to 9/16″ plate, 1.5 – 80 kW
sf-coil.summary: Cut straight from the coil: a decoiler, straightener and leveller feed the sheet onto the laser table so there is no sheet handling, no offcuts and no limit on part length. The SF15015C runs thin coil (0.031 – 0.047″) through an open-type laser; the SF1503CH takes coil to 1/8″ and 16.5 tons on a 5 × 10 ft machine; the SF2012CH levels and cuts 5/16″ to 9/16″ plate from 22-ton coils with 12 to 80 kW. The TOP line adds robot sorting, panel bending and welding for a complete coil-to-part cell.
